tha-ap420:1.1: gahetvāna agacchiṁ → gahetvā āgañchiṁ (sya-all) | Atithiṁ → atītaṁ (cck: ka.)
tha-ap420:3.4: oruddhanaditāya hi → oruddhanadikāyatiṁ (sya-all) | hi → oruddhanadikāyatiṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap420:9.1: pacchime bhave → pacchimabhave (bj) | bhave sampatte → bhavasampatte (sya-all)
tha-ap420:11.2: sampayojitaṁ → suppayojitaṁ (bj) | vāṇijjaṁ sampayojitaṁ → pāṇijaṁ suppayojitaṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap420:14.2: dhammanisantitā → dhammaṁ nibujjhitā (sya-all) | dhammanisantitā → nibujjhitā (cck: syā.)
tha-ap420:15.4:
paṭigaṇheyya → paṭiggaṇheyya (sya-all) | paṇḍito → karaṇiyaṁ kataṁ sabbaṁ bhavā ugghāṭitā mayā,
sabbāsavā parikkhīṇā natthidāni punabbhavo.
so ahaṁ vicarissāmi gāmāgāmaṁ purāpuraṁ,
namassamāno sambuddhaṁ dhammassa ca sudhammataṁ – machasaṁ (bj note)
